intro.heading: Artists and technicians, working for your art.
intro.body: Matr was started by artists, and the studio still runs on that instinct. Every finish we offer was developed alongside artists, to make their work look its best. Choose how you want to work with us.

tiers.name: Studio+
tiers.title: More from a single image.
tiers.body: Give your piece a surface with real presence: texture you can feel, relief that catches the light, or color on wood, metal or fabric.
tiers.pricing: Each piece starts with a short conversation and is priced to match.
tiers.alt: Close-up of a glossy, textured surface catching the light

tiers.name: Studio Pro
tiers.title: Your look, at scale.
tiers.body: For artists with a distinctive style who need it in quantity. We find the look with you through samples, then deliver it consistently, edition after edition.
tiers.pricing: A development fee covers the sampling. Volume earns it back through discounts.
tiers.alt: A series of works in one consistent style

tiers.name: Residency
tiers.title: Make it here, with us.
tiers.body: Work in the studio alongside Matr's artists and technicians, and make pieces you couldn't make anywhere else.
tiers.pricing: By application. Booked by the hour or the day.
tiers.alt: An artist working by hand on a finished print in the studio

menu.heading: The Studio+ menu
menu.lead: Finishes we can bring to your image. Combine them, or ask us what would suit your work.

items.title: Gestural texture
items.body: A living surface with the trace of a hand. No two pieces alike.
items.alt: A richly textured surface with visible gestural marks

items.title: Image-led texture
items.body: Texture that follows the movement in your image.
items.alt: Texture following the flow of an image

items.title: Sculpted relief
items.body: Crisp, defined relief, as precise as your file.
items.alt: A print with crisp raised relief

items.title: Beyond canvas
items.body: Your image on wood, metal, paper or fabric.
items.alt: A face printed directly onto rough, pitted cement

items.title: Relief beneath oil
items.body: Defined relief under a full oil-color surface.
items.alt: A sign image with raised relief under a glossy oil-color surface

items.title: Atmospheric color
items.body: Soft, misted gradients with a hand-made feel.
items.alt: A soft, glowing image with misted gradients

items.title: Raised line
items.body: Bold lines that stand off the surface.
items.alt: Bold raised lines standing off a printed surface
